title: NCAA: EAC fends off San Sebastian to enter win column
summary: Emilio Aguinaldo College avoided collapse to turn back San Sebastian College, 94-87, and clinch its first win in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
